description: List stored State Statistical Office of Macedonia release metadata with date and original link. This tool does not expose full reports or calculate new statistics. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `source` and the original source URL in `originalUrl`; `publisher` identifies FinPortal.mk. If `url` is null, say no matching FinPortal page is published and use `originalUrl` for verification; do not invent a route or search for other coverage unless the user asks.
name: get_dzs_releases
title: Објави од ДЗС
